entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Balcony_Intro_1
entries.dialogueText: The grand double doors of the Palas Rezna balcony swung open to the roar of over forty thousand citizens packed across the Royal Plaza. Banners of House Toras, Azaro, and Sazon fluttered in the sea breeze above brass radio microphones carrying your words to every household in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_Balcony_Whisper
entries.dialogueText: Hugo leaned in, his voice barely audible beneath the roar. "Both the realm and foreign embassies hear every syllable, Romus. Choose your message with care."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Doctrine_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: You stepped up to the stone balustrade and raised your hand. A profound hush settled over the plaza.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Speech_Revanchist
entries.dialogueText: Sons and daughters of Rizia! For over twenty-five years, our kingdom bore separation in silence. But House Toras does not bow to dictators! Today our armies march to reclaim our soil by royal steel!
entries.menuText: "Sons and daughters of Rizia! We march to restore the honor and steel of our ancestors!"
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Speech_Tone"] = "Revanchist"; Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] or 0) + 1; Variable["Zille_Smolak_Pressure"] = (Variable["Zille_Smolak_Pressure"] or 0) + 2; Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] = (Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] or 0) - 1;

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Revanchist_Reaction
entries.dialogueText: A thunderous roar erupted from the square, bayonets flashing in the sun as guardsmen snapped to salute—while foreign press attachés scribbled furiously about Rizian saber-rattling.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Speech_Liberation
entries.dialogueText: People of Rizia! We march not out of hatred, but out of sacred love for our brothers and sisters in Zille who endured Smolak's secret police and broken promises. Today we bring them home!
entries.menuText: "We march not as conquerors, but to bring our brothers and sisters in Zille safely home!"
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Speech_Tone"] = "Liberation"; Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] or 0) + 1; Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] = (Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] or 0) + 1; Variable["Zille_Leverage"] = (Variable["Zille_Leverage"] or 0) + 1;

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Liberation_Reaction
entries.dialogueText: Tears flowed among the elders in the plaza, and chants of 'Long live King Romus!' rolled down the avenues toward the harbor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Speech_Legalist
entries.dialogueText: Citizens of Rizia and observers across Merkopa: Rizia is a realm of honor and law. The 1927 treaty has expired, and in reclaiming Zille we uphold the sacred legal order Wiktor Smolak trampled underfoot!
entries.menuText: "The 1927 agreement has expired. We enforce international law where Smolak trampled it!"
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Speech_Tone"] = "Legalist"; Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] = (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] or 0) + 1; Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] = (Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] or 0) + 2; Variable["Zille_Leverage"] = (Variable["Zille_Leverage"] or 0) + 1;

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Legalist_Reaction
entries.dialogueText: Foreign correspondents nodded in sober respect as applause rolled across the square in dignified cadence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Speech_Closing_Hub
entries.dialogueText: As the first ovation ebbed, the eyes of soldiers, merchants, and diplomatic envoys alike remained fixed upon the royal balustrade. You prepared your closing vow.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Closing_Civilian_Charter
entries.dialogueText: Hear this royal vow: every Rizian, Bludish, and law-abiding Wehzek resident inside Zille will be shielded by our courts. We bring lawful peace, never blind reprisal! Glovurius axa Rizia!
entries.menuText: "I pledge before God: Rizian, Bludish, and peaceful Wehzek residents in Zille shall know law, not vengeance!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Closing_Soldier_Pride
entries.dialogueText: Let every foundry, farm, and port stand beside the soldiers marching across our border tonight! Together, Rizia is invincible! Glovurius axa Rizia!
entries.menuText: "Stand behind our divisions, fuel our depots, and victory will be ours! Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Closing_Expose_Terror
entries.dialogueText: For years our people endured Smolak's fabricated terror and extortion in Zille. Our evidence lies on the record, and our answer flies on the wind! Glovurius axa Rizia!
entries.menuText: "The world has seen Smolak's bombings and blackmail in Zille—we end his terror forever!"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Closing_Charter
entries.dialogueText: Laurento exhaled in quiet admiration as you stepped back through the gilded doors. "That civilian pledge just disarmed half our critics in Konstantium, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Ack_Closing_Workers
entries.dialogueText: The plaza thundered with cheers that shook the tall palace glass. Workers, noble retainers, and guardsmen roared as one voice.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Closing_Expose
entries.dialogueText: Foreign reporters sprinted for the telephone booths across the square as Smolak's culpability became tomorrow's headline across Merkopa.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_Balcony_Whisper
entries.dialogueText: Laurento inclined his head beside you. "Both our citizens and the ambassadors in Konstantium, Kyrute are listening to every word, Your Majesty."
